title: Rampage: World Tour
overview:
Play one of three colossal characters in this chaotic conversion of the 80's coin-op with more than 130 standard levels, 14 bonus levels, 4 grudge match levels and many more hidden levels. A wild smash'em up where just about everything in sight is destructible. Demolish buildings, swat down aircraft, devour people and destroy entire cities from London to Mexico.

It's time to bring the house down!
